_note: The till's half of the Bazaar (#174): what a free-text price is worth in
whole gold pieces. Implemented twice — backend/internal/http/money.go so
the server can charge, frontend/src/lib/money.ts so the Buy button knows
affordability without a round trip — and this file keeps them honest.
Gold only, by decision: sub-gold remainders round UP, the shopkeeper's
handling fee. A null gp means the till refuses — prose prices ("a favor
owed") are legal on a shelf and simply not buyable. Real denominations

cases.name: no space is how half the books write it
a copper rounds up to the fee
